svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body: 12 mm plate 160 x 120 mm, standing across the drum end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drive shaft 16 mm in a 17 mm hole 20 mm up from the body's bottom

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge; on it a 40 mm knurled wheel 8 mm wide that bears on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside of the chime, and a 150 mm crank outside the body.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guide roller 30 mm on a 12 mm axle, 53.5 mm above the drive shaft,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: runs on the outside of the chime: chime pinched between the two.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cutter arm: 12 mm rod from a link block on the body, 12 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round from the top, carrying the 50 mm hardened wheel square to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the head, 4 mm inside the chime wall. An M12 clamp screw presses

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it into the head; a 1.5 mm cover sits over the wheel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Torque arm: 30 x 8 mm flat, riser 88 mm, then 170 mm to the post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a drum the wheel cuts the head just inside the chime;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the torque arm rests on the post as the crank turns.
